grokFindings.issue: Missing Access Control for Owner Minting
grokFindings.recommendation: Implement an `onlyOwner` modifier on any future minting functions to restrict access to the contract owner. Also, if further minting is unnecessary, ensure that no minting functionality is introduced in future updates.

grokFindings.issue: Potential Integer Truncation in Fee Calculation
grokFindings.recommendation: Consider using SafeMath for all arithmetic operations. Also, add a check to ensure amount is at least 100, or apply more robust fee calculations logic that ensures minimum fee amount.
Emit a custom event after the fee is transferred to the owner. This event should include the sender, receiver (owner), and the amount of the fee. This improves auditability and transparency.
